title: Evaluating a Nested Composition at a Point
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: For $f(x)=x^{2}$ and $g(x)=2x+1$, compute the numeric value of $f\big(g(2)\big)$ without first deriving the general composite formula.

steps.title: Evaluate the Inner Function
steps.explanation: Feed $x=2$ into the linear rule $g(x)=2x+1$ first.
steps.why: Nested evaluations proceed from the inside outward.

steps.title: Feed the Result into the Outer Function
steps.explanation: Use the output $5$ as the input of $f(x)=x^2$, giving $25$.
steps.why: The outer function receives the previous step's output as its input.

steps.title: Cross-Check with the Composite Formula
steps.explanation: Using the general formula $(f\circ g)(x)=(2x+1)^2$ from Exercise 37 at $x=2$ reproduces $25$.
steps.why: Independent agreement between direct evaluation and the formula confirms the answer.
